objective: Audit a recognizable full-stack web application with frontend and API behavior. Exercise real user journeys, API behavior, repository/security inspection and bounded performance discovery. Report only executed evidence.

Audit a recognizable interactive web application. Treat documented intentionally vulnerable training behaviors as product context rather than automatically calling every designed challenge a regression. Focus on executed user behavior, runtime evidence and clearly scoped observations.

Audit a small recognizable web application as a low-complexity backup. Exercise the actual UI, repository structure, startup behavior and bounded performance checks. Report uncertainty when richer API behavior is not present.
